cases.question: The replacement card has been dispatched; where is the envelope now?
cases.rationale: The request concerns delivery progress of a card, with no specific card product named.

cases.question: I would like the yearly membership charge on my credit card reviewed for a refund.
cases.rationale: A yearly card membership charge belongs to the annual-fee intent rather than a disputed purchase.

cases.question: Could the total credit available on my card be raised for future purchases?
cases.rationale: The requested operation changes the total credit card limit; the amount can be collected later.

cases.question: Someone needs to pay me; show me the IBAN that belongs to my account.
cases.rationale: The user seeks their own account identifier and is not initiating a transfer.

cases.question: The person I paid says nothing has arrived; check the progress of that bank transfer.
cases.rationale: This is a status inquiry about a previously submitted transfer without a named transfer channel.

cases.question: Arrange for my water bill to be settled automatically whenever it comes due.
cases.rationale: The user wants a recurring utility payment instruction rather than a one-off payment.

cases.question: Has anyone finished assessing the borrowing application I submitted last week?
cases.rationale: The application already exists and its assessment status is requested; no loan product is specified.

cases.question: What spread are you quoting between buying and selling euros today?
cases.rationale: The user requests exchange pricing rather than placing a currency trade.

cases.question: Tell me which of my card reward points will expire next.
cases.rationale: The request concerns card reward expiry rather than a flight loyalty membership.

cases.question: I need a record showing the incoming and outgoing movements on my bank account.
cases.rationale: The user asks for account activity; no specific account product is named.

cases.question: Do not end my card membership; just pause card use until I choose to turn it back on.
cases.rationale: Permanent cancellation is explicitly rejected; the desired restriction is temporary.

cases.question: My banking login works fine; it is the card PIN that I need to replace.
cases.rationale: The user explicitly distinguishes a card PIN change from a digital banking password reset.

cases.question: I do not need to track the transfer; ask for the money I sent by mistake to be recalled.
cases.rationale: The affirmative request is recall of an already submitted transfer, not transfer tracking.

cases.question: Leave the water service connected, but remove the bank instruction that pays its bill automatically.
cases.rationale: The banking operation removes an existing autopay instruction; utility service cancellation is excluded.

cases.question: I said pay the card, but I meant tell me the outstanding card balance before I decide.
cases.rationale: The speaker retracts payment and settles on a balance inquiry, leaving one requested operation.

cases.question: Freeze the card—sorry, I already froze it; restore its use now.
cases.rationale: The corrected request reactivates a temporarily frozen card.

cases.question: What is the transfer limit—actually, I mean the fee charged for sending money?
cases.rationale: The final corrected target is the transfer fee, not the sending limit.

cases.question: Track my loan application—no, that was approved; I want to settle the remaining loan debt early.
cases.rationale: The speaker replaces the application-status request with early settlement of existing debt.

cases.question: uh that shop charge on my card, the same purchase shows twice, twice, I want to dispute it
cases.rationale: Constructed repetitions preserve a clear request to dispute a duplicate card purchase.

cases.question: can you, um, turn on the online buying permission for this card
cases.rationale: Written disfluency does not change the request to enable online card purchases.

cases.question: how much money is there in my account that I can, can actually use right now
cases.rationale: The repeated phrase still requests available account funds without identifying a specific product.

cases.question: my card is gone, er, someone took it from my bag, report it stolen please
cases.rationale: The constructed disfluency retains an explicit stolen-card report; card details can be collected later.

cases.question: Terminate this card membership permanently even though I still have the card.
cases.rationale: Permanent membership termination differs from a temporary freeze or lost-card report.

cases.question: Make a payment for the minimum due on my credit card this month.
cases.rationale: The user requests execution of a card payment rather than asking what is owed.

cases.question: Start a new bank transfer to a recipient I have not paid before.
cases.rationale: The operation creates a new transfer; no earlier transfer needs tracking or recall.

cases.question: Before I send anything, what is the maximum amount allowed in one bank transfer?
cases.rationale: This asks about the permitted sending amount rather than a transfer fee or card limit.

cases.question: Can you change that for me before it happens?
cases.rationale: The object and operation depend on missing prior context and cannot be assigned reliably.

cases.question: I need help with a charge on my card.
cases.rationale: The message does not identify a purchase dispute, an annual membership fee, or another charge issue.

cases.question: I need a different limit.
cases.rationale: The message does not identify whether a card limit, transfer limit, or another limit is involved.

cases.question: Reset my card PIN and send me a bank account statement as well.
cases.rationale: Card PIN maintenance and account statement retrieval are two distinct requested operations with no chosen first task.

cases.question: Close my bank account and start a new loan application.
cases.rationale: Account closure and a loan application are separate requests requiring a choice of operation.

cases.question: Track the delivery of my card and check when my card reward points expire.
cases.rationale: Card delivery tracking and reward-expiry inquiry are independent goals.

cases.question: Explain how to bake a loaf using only flour, water, salt, and yeast.
cases.rationale: Bread preparation is outside the banking catalog.

cases.question: Reserve a seat on a train from the coast to the capital for tomorrow.
cases.rationale: Train reservation is not a banking operation in this catalog.

cases.question: I want a live bank representative to take over this conversation.
cases.rationale: The user explicitly requests transfer to a human representative; handoff carries no intent label.

cases.question: Please connect me with a person from customer service rather than continuing the automated chat.
cases.rationale: The affirmative request is a human-service handoff, without another operation to route.

cases.question: Make the total 27500 TRY.

messages.content: I would like to increase the total credit limit on my card.
What should your new total card limit be in TRY?

cases.rationale: The answer supplies the pending new_limit for the active credit-limit workflow.

cases.question: Sorry, 28500 TRY is the total I meant.

messages.content: Make the total 27500 TRY.
The requested new total is 27500 TRY. Shall I proceed?

cases.rationale: The user corrects a collected amount within the same active workflow rather than starting another operation.

cases.question: Stop this limit-change request; keep the current limit as it is.

messages.content: Sorry, 28500 TRY is the total I meant.
I have updated the requested total to 28500 TRY. Shall I proceed?

cases.rationale: The user cancels the pending active change before confirmation; the label remains the active intent.

cases.question: Show me my own IBAN so that someone can pay me.

messages.content: Stop this limit-change request; keep the current limit as it is.
The limit-change request has been stopped.

cases.rationale: The previous workflow is cancelled; the latest turn introduces a distinct account-identifier request.

cases.question: The last four are 0426.

messages.content: Someone stole my card from my bag.
What are the last four digits of the lost card?

cases.rationale: The synthetic four-digit identifier fills the pending card_last4 slot in the stolen-card workflow.

cases.question: Yes, go ahead with securing that card.

messages.content: The last four are 0426.
Shall I proceed with the lost-card action for the card ending 0426?

cases.rationale: The user confirms the active workflow after its required slot has been supplied.

cases.question: Please put a human adviser in charge of this missing-card issue.

messages.content: Yes, go ahead with securing that card.
Your request has been submitted for processing.

cases.rationale: An explicit human handoff takes precedence over continuing the active card workflow.

cases.question: While I wait, I would like a record of my bank account transactions.

messages.content: Please put a human adviser in charge of this missing-card issue.
A representative has been requested. You may ask another question while waiting.

cases.rationale: The new question asks for account transaction records rather than further action on the lost card.

cases.question: Just find out whether the earlier transfer arrived.

messages.content: I need help with a bank transfer.
Do you want to send a new transfer or check one you already submitted?

cases.rationale: The clarification reply selects tracking of an existing transfer rather than creation of a new one.

cases.question: The reference is SYNTHETIC-TR-008.

messages.content: Just find out whether the earlier transfer arrived.
What is the reference number of the transfer?

cases.rationale: The explicitly synthetic reference supplies the pending transfer_reference for the active lookup.

cases.question: Cancel this lookup; I do not want to check it now.

messages.content: The reference is SYNTHETIC-TR-008.
Shall I look up the transfer with reference SYNTHETIC-TR-008?

cases.rationale: This cancels the active status lookup, not the underlying transfer transaction.

cases.question: I still want the money sent earlier to be recalled.

messages.content: Cancel this lookup; I do not want to check it now.
The status lookup has been stopped. The transfer itself has not been cancelled.

cases.rationale: The latest turn requests recall of the underlying transfer after cancelling only its status lookup.
